key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Panel box for the island pill
key.description: Which top bar box the pill is placed in.

key.name: panel-index
key.summary: Ordering index within the panel box
key.description: Position of the pill inside the chosen top bar box.

key.name: always-show
key.summary: Show the pill with zero sessions
key.description: When false the pill is hidden entirely while no agent session is active.

key.name: permission-timeout
key.description: Seconds to wait for a decision before falling through to the agent's own prompt. Zero waits indefinitely.

key.name: question-timeout
key.description: Seconds to wait for an answer before falling through to the agent's own picker. Longer than the permission timeout because a question has to be read. Zero waits indefinitely.

key.name: auto-open-on-permission
key.summary: Auto-expand the popup on a permission request
key.description: Suppressed while a fullscreen window is on the primary monitor.

key.name: enabled-agents
key.description: Independent of hook installation. An agent with no hooks installed simply never sends events.

key.name: done-linger
key.summary: Seconds a finished session stays visible
key.description: How long a session in the done state remains in the popup before it is dropped.
